a.lede: The new rules restrict chip exports and also access to their computing power, which China relies on heavily.
a.title: How new US chip restrictions on South East Asia will hit China

b.lede: Under the interim rule, the U.S. will require firms to get licenses to export AI chips if they may provide compute to China or other restricted countries.
b.title: US tightens AI chip export controls to deter Chinese companies from accessing compute remotely
